name: Bug Report
description: Report a bug or issue with the extension.
title: "[BUG]"
labels: bug
assignees: ''
about: This template is for reporting bugs encountered while using the TypePilot extension.

---

## Description
Please describe the bug you encountered. Include any relevant details that may help us understand the issue.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. **Step 1:** Describe the first action taken (e.g., "Open Gmail and start a new email").
2. **Step 2:** Describe the next action taken (e.g., "Click in the message body and type the trigger `/reply`").
3. **Step 3:** Continue detailing each action taken leading up to the bug (e.g., "Fill in the form that appears and click Insert").
4. **Step 4:** Describe any final actions or conditions (e.g., "Observe that the trigger text stays in the email and the snippet is not inserted").

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen after following the steps.

## Snippet
If the bug involves a specific snippet, paste its trigger and body here. Please remove any personal or confidential information first.

```
Trigger: /example
Body: Hello {formtext:name}, ...
```

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here, such as the website where it happened, your TypePilot version (shown at `chrome://extensions`), your Chrome version, and your operating system.
